visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and a lavender cardigan stands outside a FamilyMart convenience store under bright natural daylight. She waves enthusiastically and smiles at the camera, then turns to walk through the automatic glass sliding doors into the bright interior of the store. (2) Inside the store, the camera focuses on refrigerated shelves filled with desserts. A hand with manicured nails reaches for and picks up a yellow cup labeled with Japanese text for pudding. The background is a typical clean, well-lit Japanese convenience store environment with various snacks. (3) The pudding is shown being opened on a textured outdoor ledge. A clear plastic spoon is used to scoop out the smooth, pale yellow custard, revealing a dark liquid caramel sauce underneath. The lighting is natural and bright, highlighting the glossy texture of the food. (4) Back in the store, a bottle of strawberry milk is selected from a shelf packed with colorful juice cartons. The pink liquid and pieces of fruit are visible. The camera then cuts to a black-packaged cream puff, which is later broken open by hand to reveal a rich, dark chocolate cream filling. (5) A white packaged bun labeled Hattendo is shown. A hand pulls the soft, pale yellow bun apart, revealing a dense and creamy custard center. The scene then shifts to the woman outdoors in a lush green park-like setting, taking a bite of the bun with a look of surprise and delight.
